technical_quality: Adequate PA film: good inspiration, no significant rotation, adequate penetration, L side marker present in the image upper right corner confirming conventional orientation.

devices.type: L side marker (external radiographic marker, not a medical device)
devices.location: image upper right corner, over patient's left shoulder region

abnormalities.finding: Mildly increased perihilar bronchovascular markings, possible mild pulmonary vascular congestion; no Kerley B lines, peribronchial cuffing, or alveolar opacity
Prominent / full left hilum, possibly enlarged left pulmonary artery

description_zh: PA 正位胸部X光，影像右上角可見「L」側別標記，吸氣量尚可，無明顯旋轉。心臟大小約在正常範圍，縱膈未見增寬，氣管居中；兩側肺門周圍支氣管血管紋理輕度增粗，左側肺門稍顯飽滿，但未見明確 Kerley B 線、支氣管周圍套袖徵或肺泡型浸潤。兩側肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸，橫膈輪廓清晰，左側橫膈下可見胃泡氣體。未見任何管路、導線、心律調節器或手術夾等植入物；標籤所述之肺水腫在本片僅有輕微且不確定的肺門血管增粗表現，無法確認。
